On August 28, 2026, the Board of Directors of NXP Semiconductors N.V. (the “Company”) approved the payment of an interim dividend of $1.014 per ordinary share for the third quarter of 2026. The interim dividend will be paid on October 8, 2026 to the Company’s shareholders of record as of September 16, 2026. A copy of the Company's press release announcing the dividend payment is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K, and is incorporated by reference herein.
